name: 95360 · Newman, CA
findings: ZIP 95360 (Newman) has 22 nonprofit organizations. 10 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 10 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (40% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 95360 (Newman) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 95360 (Newman) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.7 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 9 organizations here; 36% of all organizations here have no identified type.
